decision.quote: Q06 就按 A来收口，但是左侧导航栏可以支持点击折叠，只露出图标
decision.navigationQuote: 左侧导航栏只放 2 级页面跟3级页面

layout.name: 连续导航轨
layout.description: 一级职责导航在顶部；二级与三级页面在左侧导航树；窄屏沿用局部横向导航轨。
layout.context: 面包屑只表达真实路径、领域范围和当前位置；领域选择器保留原位。
layout.secondary: 宽屏224px左侧手动折叠为图标；二级父项可展开三级子页面；窄屏沿用横向导航轨。
layout.tertiary: 三级页面缩进显示在所属二级页面下；当前组自动展开；对象内部视图不进入全局导航。

navigation.desktop: secondary parent rows with indexed icons; tertiary pages indent under their parent
navigation.activeGroup: expand the active secondary parent; only the active group is auto-expanded after route changes
navigation.collapse: retain secondary icons and accessible labels; hide tertiary labels until expanded
navigation.narrow: keep the existing horizontal rail; secondary and tertiary links remain in the same local rail
